description.value:
You launch a small stinging dart at a creature within 120 feet, making a ranged tech attack against it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 poison damage, and if it is a humanoid or a beast, it cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn.

This power's damage grows as you gain levels, becoming 2d8 at 5th level, 3d8 at 11th level, and 4d8 at 17th level.
